summary: Verified PDF/DOCX ingestion fix and free-text tagging in /archivos. Backend: 6/6 pytest cases passed on public URL (fabrica domain, activator valid). PDF (reportlab) and DOCX (python-docx) contents are correctly extracted by server.extraer_texto_documento (no more '[Archivo binario:...]'), texto_concatenado feeds the RAG procesar_expediente and returns documentos_procesados=3 with estado='completado'. Free-text with 'Etiqueta: cumpleaños' prefix also processes correctly. Frontend: /archivos exposes escritura-libre-etiqueta-input above escritura-libre-input, click on procesar-embudo-btn triggers backend flow, asistente-sugerencia card appears with action label, and confirmar/corregir + guardar flow works (backend responds 'Corrección anotada.').
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is very large (>2000 lines); consider splitting activation, aprendiz, bimestral, and ingesta routers into separate modules for maintainability.
extraer_texto_documento imports pdfplumber/docx lazily inside the function — fine for optional deps, but a single import at module top would surface missing deps earlier.
Out-of-scope but noted by main agent: lazo_generico.py trajectories still use fixed CVD Grafeno domain vocabulary instead of the active domain language.
test_credentials: N/A (no auth; fabrica domain preconfigured with valid activator).
seed_data_creation: Test expedientes are prefixed TEST_ and deleted in fixture teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fix for PDF/DOCX ingestion is confirmed working end-to-end. Active domain remains 'fabrica'. Frontend etiqueta input is directly above the textarea in /archivos and its value is prepended as 'Etiqueta: {etiqueta}\n\n{texto}' before upload as escritura_libre.txt. Asistente sugerencia and corregir/confirmar flow using /api/aprendiz/{dominio}/decision-asistente endpoint works.
